scope: independent second-round QA backend preparation only

execution.authorization: Human second-round approval verified by root; actual fixed main/QA/target binding is still required

selfValidation.productMeaning: QA pure oracles only; no product acceptance claim
selfValidation.typecheck: backend files typechecked; latest complete directory check currently blocked only by concurrent driver-factories.ts:90 missing GatewaySimulator.setMemberRole

interfaceNeeds: Root provides authorized QaEnvironment per case and recorded lifecycle; do not call standalone bypassing execution gate.
Root binds owned runtime/capacity controllers with module-tick, admission-hold, agent-lifecycle-witness and activity-witness.
Freeze new P1-04 work-window contract source and exact final main revision; SQL fault identity change only applies to new POL008, does not replace POL003 public transition.
Provider owner binds HTTP200/500/invalid output/usage variants with real service UUID to actual wire request evidence, not array index.
limitations: Most pre-existing case modes still describe preparation-time manual/existing-regression; root must reconcile runtime dispatch and catalog without inventing execution.
Per-variant PASS cannot make an incomplete case PASS; driver returns BLOCKED for all explicitly uncovered variants.
Finite observation timeout is BLOCKED unless an actual assertion demonstrates a product contradiction; infrastructure exceptions are not product FAIL.
Repeated product runs cannot erase first failures; no retries are introduced.
First-round timing interpretation/human confirmation are not reopened.
